title: •I Want That Ship
caption: •I Want That Ship (V)
game_text: Deploy on your battleground. During battle, whenever opponent’s card is hit by a non-{permanent-weapon} (once per card targeted), opponent’s total power is cumulatively -4 (-2 if hit by a lightsaber).
lore: Like nerf herders herding nerfs, Imperial commanders often use TIE fighters to drive fleeing Rebel ships into tractor beam range.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT. Inline icon after 'non-' is the black square with a green blade; per STANDARD rev 8 that glyph is the Permanent Weapon icon (the text continues '(-2 if hit by a lightsaber)', and GEMP's later VB text reads 'non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon') → {permanent-weapon} (renders the same image as {lightsaber}; the brief's default token would be {lightsaber}); the wiki stub reads it as 'non-lightsaber' (differs). Curly apostrophes in opponent’s (twice). Lore matches the scan (no quotes). Only a 350 px scan exists; copyright 1997 (Dagobah) by set, not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px).
